question: Which restaurant can be found within 20 kilometers while moving north from the View Lounge, San Francisco, CA?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.404326 37.785414)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360));

answers.description: Catalan and French bistro (merged space of B44 and Café Bastille)
